description: Generate a free daily bid brief from the full CanadaBuys and Alberta APC catalogues for any business. Pass an inline `profile` to describe the business per call. Best fits start with the same TypeSafe Jev supply classification as find_business_fit. Domestic-preference flags are included when a matched notice carries them. When configured, search terms or business capabilities may be sent to Cohere to select commodity filters. See /privacy. When a business description is present and TypeSafe is configured, notice text and that description are sent to TypeSafe for supply-fit classification. See /privacy.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

days.description: Look ahead this many days for matches and deadlines (default 14)

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

profile.description: Inline business profile used for this call only. Overrides any saved profile. On the shared public endpoint without a subscriber key, this is the way to describe your business.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability keywords; derived from description when omitted

description.description: What the business does: products, services, capabilities

industries.description: Optional sector labels for any business. Steel, lumber, aluminum, and construction still work. So do software, healthcare, energy, mining, training, or your own wording. Labels rank matches. They do not hide other contracts.

location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Edmonton, Alberta'

name: daily_bid_brief
title: Get my daily bid brief
